title: This week's hottest mathematics papers on arXiv

sections.title: A Complete Resolution of Forsythe's Conjecture for Restarted Conjugate Gradients
sections.abstract: The paper classifies exactly when restarted conjugate-gradient residual directions converge, proving the conjecture for restart lengths 1–3 and constructing counterexamples for every length at least 4.
sections.claimed_result: The universal convergence conclusion holds for s=1,2,3 and fails for every s≥4.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Exact-arithmetic restarted conjugate-gradient iteration on finite-dimensional real symmetric positive-definite problems.
sections.caveat: Preprint; floating-point implementations are outside the stated setting.

sections.title: A unified family of counterexamples to Batyrev's non-negativity conjecture on stringy Hodge numbers
sections.abstract: The paper places known counterexamples to Batyrev's conjecture into a three-parameter family and derives a master formula for their stringy Hodge numbers.
sections.claimed_result: A structure formula isolates the term responsible for possible negativity and gives a parameter classification.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Singular projective hypersurfaces with a linear singular locus and their log resolutions.
sections.caveat: The classification is for the stated family and parameter range.

sections.title: Unimodality shenanigans in Ehrhart theory
sections.abstract: The paper constructs counterexamples to Stanley's unimodality conjecture for h*-polynomials of IDP polytopes and to related log-concavity conjectures.
sections.claimed_result: Cayley-sum constructions yield nonunimodal and non-log-concave examples, including smooth examples.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: IDP, Gorenstein, and very ample polytopes and their Ehrhart series.
sections.caveat: The constructions require checking the detailed examples and proofs.

sections.title: Sharp Hessian integrability for fully nonlinear elliptic supersolutions in low dimensions
sections.abstract: The paper claims the sharp planar W^{2,ε} exponent for viscosity supersolutions and extends the mechanism to a three-dimensional regime.
sections.claimed_result: ε₂(κ)=2/(κ+1) in the plane and ε₃(κ)=3/(2κ+1) for 1≤κ≤4.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Viscosity supersolutions of fully nonlinear uniformly elliptic equations.
sections.caveat: The three-dimensional result leaves a gap beyond the stated ellipticity range.

sections.title: A sharp covering theorem and Solyanik estimates for Euclidean balls
sections.abstract: The paper proves a conjectured low-multiplicity covering theorem for dilated Euclidean balls and derives optimal maximal-operator asymptotics.
sections.claimed_result: The optimal multiplicity exponent and Solyanik asymptotic are established.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Euclidean balls in R^n, n≥2, and the uncentered Hardy–Littlewood maximal operator.
sections.caveat: The conclusions are specific to the stated Euclidean-ball settings.

sections.title: A counterexample to Kenig's conjecture for the Laplace double-layer operator
sections.abstract: The paper constructs a simply connected planar Lipschitz domain whose Laplace double-layer operator has essential spectral radius greater than 1/2.
sections.claimed_result: For t>1/2 sufficiently close to 1/2, ±it lie in the Fredholm essential spectrum.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Laplace double-layer operators on bounded planar Lipschitz domains and periodic Lipschitz graphs.
sections.caveat: The construction is specialized and computer-assisted.

sections.title: A Counterexample to a Conjecture of Liu and Qian and a Refined Inverse Theorem for Restricted Sumsets in Z_p
sections.abstract: The paper refutes a proposed inverse theorem for critical restricted sumsets in Z_p and proves a refined theorem under |A|+|B|≤p−1.
sections.claimed_result: The Liu–Qian conjecture fails at |A|+|B|=p; a refined inverse theorem holds below that boundary.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Nonempty subsets of the prime cyclic group Z_p with unequal sizes.
sections.caveat: The boundary case remains only partially resolved.

sections.title: Counterexamples to Two Converse Conjectures for the Morley Tetrahedron and a New Conjecture
sections.abstract: The paper gives counterexamples to two proposed converses about Morley tetrahedra and proves the replacement conjecture in several symmetric cases.
sections.claimed_result: Several symmetry-restricted cases are proved, while a new general conjecture remains open.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Euclidean tetrahedra and Morley tetrahedra under specified symmetry conditions.
sections.caveat: The central new conjecture is not proved.
